out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD TRAYS SETTING ON HANDWASHING SINK IN WAREWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: FOOD TRAYS MOVED TO THE THREE-VAT SINK. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CARAMEL FRAPPE MIX AND YOGURT FRAPPE MIX, BOTH MADE WITH DAIRY, AT 50F IN THE FRAPPE COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: DISPOSED OF. TCS FOODS MUST BE AT 41F OR BELOW WHILE IN COOLERS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. Observed handwashing sink at the front counter and by the drive through window lacked a handwashing sign
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC replaced handwashing sign

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: inside of the 1 door under counter cooler next to the drive through window window (5 in report) needs to be cleaned
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC agreed to clean the inside of the 1 door under counter cooler

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: EHS observed PIC during time of inspection did not have a read agreed and signed employee health policy on file.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. PIC read agreed and signed an employee health policy during time of inspection. Reviewed with EHS about having a read agreed and signed copy for all staff.
